title: Address PR 101 treasure table review feedback
description: Fix PR #101 before merge. Accepted review items: wire treasure tables through runImporter with a bounded fail-closed section, add pipeline coverage for emitted treasure table records, add malformed-column-block regression coverage, and remove stale duplicate README/comments.
close_reason: PR #101 review feedback addressed; treasure tables wired through runImporter; malformed-block safety and docs cleanup verified.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Review evaluation: accepted. runImporter currently calls parseTables(coreRulePages), so treasure tables outside the coreRules slice are parser-only. Required fix is to add a bounded fail-closed treasure section, feed it into table parsing, add pipeline assertions, add malformed-column-block regression coverage, and clean stale docs/comments without broadening importer scope beyond treasure tables.
